references.text: Nethanel, son of Zuar, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Issachar in the census.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, is the leader of the tribe of Issachar in the camp arrangement, and the strength of the tribe is noted.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Issachar at the dedication of the altar.
Issachar was born as a son of Jacob, and the tribe bearing his name is mentioned here.
The sons of Issachar are listed among those who went down to Egypt, which marks the origin of the tribe.
